newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA FOREX RESERVES AT $126 BILLION AT END-JULY.
newsitem.headline: CHINA FOREX RESERVES AT $126 BILLION AT END-JULY.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves stood at $126 billion at the end of July, the central bank, the People's Bank, said in a statement on Thursday.
That marked an increase of $21 billion from the start of the year, it said.
China's foreign reserves stood at $120.94 billion at end-June and are now the world's second largest, exceeded only by Japan.
The figures indicated the reserves were growing faster than officials had earlier forecast. China had said it expected reserves to grow by $20 billion for the whole year.
